lines.text: Every night, it piles up. Reviews. Surveys. Chats. And nobody's answering.
Meet Alfie. The Experience Agent from Momos.
While it types, Alfie checks the order, applies your recovery policy, and adds the points.
Before the guest has even closed the app.
On every channel your guests use.
And when your team steps in, Alfie hands over the full story.
Book a demo at momos dot com slash Alfie.
